rules.description: A refusal or an ambiguity MUST name its reason. This is the one rule that keeps the three-member result vocabulary honest: `ambiguous` exists so that an unconfirmable external completion can be stated rather than guessed, and without this rule it degrades into a way to record 'something happened' with no obligation to say what — which is worse than the two-member vocabulary it replaced, because it looks like more information while carrying less.
